import.title: Import from Excel
import.intro: Bring in clients and policies from an Excel or CSV file. Use one row per policy: a client with two policies has two rows with the same NIC or mobile number.
import.templateNote: Start from the template, or use your own file. The app matches the columns for you.
import.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 3,000 rows.
import.matchIntro: Check that each item points at the right column. Name and mobile are needed; everything else is optional.
import.policySection: Policy (only rows with a policy number)
import.policyNote: Empty “Pays”: life policies are taken as monthly, others yearly. No start date: the next due date is used. No next due date: the next payment date from today is worked out, so put the date of any premium that's already late in “Next due”.
import.problemsFix: These rows won't be imported. Fix them in the file and import it again: rows already added are skipped.
import.nothing: Nothing new to add from this file.
import.privacy: The file is read on the server and not kept. Only the rows you import are saved.
